verdict.rationale: Supabase ships first-party background automation. Supabase Cron schedules recurring jobs, from every second to yearly, via SQL or a Dashboard UI. Those jobs can run SQL, database functions, or HTTP calls to Edge Functions, and Supabase Queues adds durable background task processing. Database Webhooks fire automatically on INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE events. The AI-native angle is present but thin: the MCP docs give guardrails for unattended agent routines, and the AI Assistant can generate and deploy functions. Missing for 10: a first-party runner for autonomous AI-agent routines (the documented unattended routines run in an external agent host), detail on monitoring and retry behaviour of automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
